name: Menemen
reasons: Technique baked -> pan_fry; follow the stored preparation steps, not the dish title.
Onion/pepper 5 min + tomato 8 min already exceeds the old cook time; allow 4 min to set the eggs.

steps.display_text: Sauté diced onion and sliced green pepper in olive oil over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add diced or grated tomatoes. Cook until sauce thickens, about 8 minutes.
Season with paprika and red pepper flakes.
Crack eggs directly into the sauce. Stir gently to scramble into soft, loose curds.
Remove from heat when eggs are just set but still creamy. Serve directly in the pan with bread.

name: Miso Soup
reasons: Withdraw the unverified vegetarian claim: dashi / roast gravy is unspecified. Restore only after confirming a vegetarian variant; ingredients are not silently substituted.

steps.display_text: Bring dashi stock to a gentle simmer (do not boil).
Rehydrate dried wakame in cold water for 5 minutes, then drain.
Dissolve miso paste in a ladle of hot stock, then stir back into the pot.
Add cubed tofu and wakame. Heat gently for 1 minute without boiling.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with sliced green onion. Serve immediately.

name: Mtsvadi (Georgian Grilled Pork Skewers)
reasons: Include the mandatory minimum 60 min marinade.

steps.display_text: Cut the pork into large, even cubes.
Slice one onion into rings and grate the other.
Mix the pork with the grated onion, oil, salt, and pepper, and marinate for at least 1 hour, ideally longer.
Thread the pork onto skewers, alternating with the onion rings.
Grill over hot coals or a very hot grill pan, turning regularly, for 15-18 minutes until cooked through and charred at the edges.
Serve hot off the skewer, drizzled with pomegranate molasses if using, with fresh bread.

name: Nachos
reasons: Technique fried -> baked; follow the stored preparation steps, not the dish title.

steps.display_text: Preheat oven to 200°C. Spread chips in a single layer on a baking tray.
Sprinkle generously with grated cheddar and Monterey Jack.
Scatter sliced jalapeños over the cheese.
Bake for 8–10 minutes until cheese is fully melted and edges are golden.
Serve immediately with salsa, sour cream, and guacamole on the side.

name: New York Cheesecake
reasons: Allow 70 min baking, 60 min oven cooling and an editorial 8 h overnight chill, plus 25 min preparation. Overnight duration is an estimate, not specified numerically in source.

steps.display_text: Crush graham crackers and mix with melted butter. Press into the base of a springform tin. Chill.
Beat cream cheese until smooth. Add sugar, vanilla, sour cream, and mix until silky.
Add eggs one at a time, mixing on low speed — do not over-mix to avoid cracks.
Pour batter over the crust. Wrap the tin base in foil and place in a water bath.
Bake at 160°C for 60–70 minutes until the edges are set but centre still jiggles.
Turn off oven, leave door ajar and let cheesecake cool inside for 1 hour. Then refrigerate overnight.

name: Okroshka
reasons: Technique simmered -> raw; follow the stored preparation steps. Cold assembled dishes use the existing raw category, which does not imply all ingredients are uncooked.

steps.display_text: Dice cucumber, radish, and bologna into small even cubes. Chop hard-boiled eggs.
Combine all ingredients in a large bowl or soup pot.
Season with salt, a pinch of mustard, and a squeeze of lemon.
Pour cold kvass over everything until submerged. Stir.
Serve immediately in chilled bowls with a large spoonful of sour cream and fresh dill.

name: Olivier Salad
reasons: Include the mandatory minimum 60 min refrigeration before serving.

steps.display_text: Boil potatoes and carrots (with skins on) until tender. Cool completely, then peel and dice small.
Hard-boil eggs for 10 minutes. Cool, peel, and dice.
Dice bologna sausage and pickled cucumbers into small even pieces.
Drain canned peas.
Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Fold in mayonnaise until well coated.
Season with salt and pepper. Refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving for flavours to meld.

name: Pad Thai
reasons: Include the mandatory 30 min noodle soak; conservative estimate without assuming overlap.

steps.display_text: Soak flat rice noodles in cold water for 30 minutes. Drain.
Mix the sauce: fish sauce, tamarind paste, sugar, and a dash of oyster sauce.
Stir-fry shrimp or chicken in very hot oiled wok until cooked. Push to the side.
Crack eggs into the wok and scramble briefly, then mix with the protein.
Add noodles and sauce. Toss everything on high heat for 2–3 minutes.
Add bean sprouts and green onion, toss once more. Serve with crushed peanuts, lime, and chili flakes.

name: Pašticada (Dalmatian Pot Roast)
reasons: Technique pan_fry -> braised; follow the stored preparation steps, not the dish title.

steps.display_text: Lard the beef with pieces of garlic. Marinate overnight in red wine with vegetables and herbs.
Pat meat dry and brown in oil on all sides until deeply seared.
Sauté the marinade vegetables briefly. Add back the meat.
Add red wine, tomato paste, prunes, and cloves. Season with salt.
Braise on very low heat for 2.5–3 hours until meat is fork-tender.
Remove meat, blend the sauce until smooth. Slice meat and serve in sauce with homemade gnocchi.

name: Pelmeni
reasons: Technique baked -> boiled; follow the stored preparation steps, not the dish title.
From-scratch dough and hand-shaped dumplings need an editorial 45 min active allowance; include the stated 30 min rest and 15 min cooking/boiling allowance.
Remove the under-30 tag because corrected elapsed time exceeds 30 minutes.

steps.display_text: Make stiff dough from flour, egg, water, and salt. Knead and rest 30 minutes.
Mix minced pork and beef with finely grated onion, salt, and black pepper.
Roll dough thin and cut rounds. Fill each with a small ball of meat.
Fold into a half-moon, seal edges, then bring the two corners together and pinch to form the classic shape.
Boil in salted water for 7–8 minutes after they float.
Toss with butter. Serve with sour cream and a splash of vinegar, or in the cooking broth.
